name: entraadm-mcp
description: Microsoft Entra ID sign-in and audit-log triage MCP server, packaged as a Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: entraadm-mcp
plugins.description: Microsoft Entra ID sign-in and audit-log triage MCP for Claude Code. Investigate why a sign-in failed (AADSTS-annotated), tenant-wide failure trends and password-spray suspects, who changed what in the directory, and whether MFA is registered for an account, plus a one-shot daily_brief. Read-only — no write calls anywhere in this package. Needs either app-only credentials (ENTRAADM_TENANT_ID/_CLIENT_ID/_CLIENT_SECRET) or an existing `az login` session already present on the machine; the plugin cannot create or supply those for you.
